name: Dilip Mohapatra

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Dilip Mohapatra is a poet and former Indian Navy commodore. His writing career reaches back to the 1970s, and his collections include A Pinch of Sun & Other Poems and Different Shades, published by Authorspress. A publisher’s profile places this literary life alongside a career in naval service and corporate leadership.

His Kabita Live poems often question the roles people are expected to play. ‘Reclusion’ follows the cost of self-effacement, while ‘Joker in the Pack’ turns a playing card into an image of identity shaped by others. In ‘Lost and Found’, the difficulties of ageing give way to the fellowship of a reunion; ‘Dots and Dashes’ finds value in life’s interruptions and imperfections.
